verdict.rationale: Running a SaaS invoicing product headlessly through an API or CLI is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented API, CLI, SDK or CI usage. The in-app scheduled and recurring invoices are adjacent automation features, not headless operation. The probe only shows 404s for the API docs markdown and OpenAPI paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
